verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented webhook, outbound HTTP callback, or event-stream subscription for sign-ups, sign-ins, or user changes. The brute-force event types, generic code extensibility, metrics/OpenTelemetry, and account history are adjacent features, not a subscribable event delivery mechanism.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to webhooks or event streams for auth events (sign-ups, sign-ins, user changes) to keep my systems in sync
